name: Choose a search
inputs: Location/city, category, budget and move-in; supported options only.
authorization: Public browsing needs no account.
operation: Serialize typed filters into the canonical discovery URL and execute supported query.
destination: P04/P05/P06/P07; query response with opaque cursor and total-scope label.
writes: No durable user write; URL/local navigation context only.
next: Refine, open a card or authenticate for a protected action.
failure: Reject unsupported city/filter visibly; never silently fall back to Bengaluru.
returnBehavior: The same query is restored from URL; Back returns to the landing draft.

name: Open a stable entity
inputs: entityType + persisted ID + safe origin context.
authorization: Authorize public listing/member/publisher/relationship scope before returning fields.
operation: Read entity-by-ID projection and related authorized references.
destination: P08/P09/P12/P22 according to entity type.
writes: No business-state write; optional privacy-safe analytics is separate.
next: Inspect, save, contact, manage or go back.
failure: Distinguish not-found/unavailable/permission/network; do not infer missing from an absent feed card.
returnBehavior: Deep link re-fetches by ID; preserve query/filter/scroll return context.

name: Authenticate and resume
inputs: Provider/email credentials and allowlisted return descriptor.
authorization: Supported Auth provider; validate return path.
operation: Authenticate; hydrate own account; route to missing prerequisites or original destination.
destination: P03 or original authorized view.
writes: Auth identity/session; private/public initial account writes only on actual registration.
next: Review the original intended action; no automatic sending/approval.
failure: Inline accessible error; retain nonsensitive draft; close returns to origin.
returnBehavior: Session restoration precedes private rendering; retry return context is safe and owned.

name: Finish shared setup
inputs: Name/city/locality, concurrent goals and explicit discoverability decision.
authorization: Self only; meaningful essentials validated server-side.
operation: Commit profile/setup version and requested public projection consent.
destination: Original context or chosen discovery section.
writes: Private profile + disclosure/intent version; no staff/trust/occupancy mutation.
next: Complete optional preferences, create a draft or request communication.
failure: Keep unsaved choices and field errors; optional questions may be skipped as unknown.
returnBehavior: Resume saved setup progress; never publish a card from an abandoned draft.

name: Save/remove a bookmark
inputs: Typed entity reference and desired saved boolean.
authorization: Self write; current entity access checked without requiring public discoverability for an existing authorized reference.
operation: Idempotently set desired bookmark state; return saved version.
destination: Same view and P10.
writes: Own bookmark record only.
next: Open Saved or continue browsing.
failure: Revert pending affordance and retain prior confirmed state; do not announce success on failure.
returnBehavior: Read authoritative typed bookmarks and hydrate IDs independently.

name: Submit listing interest
inputs: listingId, listing version, recipient publisher UID, required answer snapshot, optional introduction.
authorization: Published/available listing; not self; no block; valid answers; quota only if a new pair request is created.
operation: Create listing Inquiry/Application and attach or create pair ConsentRequest atomically/idempotently.
destination: P08 confirmation; P11 and recipient P16/P13.
writes: Application + optional new request/quota event + durable notification outbox.
next: Withdraw interest; await explicit consent, or open existing accepted chat.
failure: Listing changed/filled → review current data; preserve answers but do not charge or submit stale interest.
returnBehavior: Show the authoritative application and pair state, not a repeated submission form.

name: Request person connection
inputs: Target UID, optional contextual note, request intent and idempotency key.
authorization: Authorized profile; not self; no direction blocked; recipient-open policy; allowance available.
operation: Create one versioned pair request and quota consumption with recipient event.
destination: P11 Sent and corresponding person/card actions.
writes: Pair request + usage event + outbox; no application or listing occupancy change.
next: Withdraw while pending or await decision.
failure: Reverse pending request becomes Incoming action; duplicate returns same result; exhaustion shows real renewal/recovery.
returnBehavior: Pending/accepted/closed state is read by pair UID, not local optimistic flag.

name: Accept communication
inputs: Request ID + expected version.
authorization: Recipient only; current pending state; both accounts eligible; no block.
operation: Transition pending → accepted and update derived pair authorization in one trusted transaction.
destination: Accepted actions + optional open P12.
writes: Consent decision + authorization mirror + notification event.
next: Message or continue separate applicant review.
failure: Concurrent withdraw/block wins by version; refresh actual state, never overwrite it with acceptance.
returnBehavior: Both users see accepted state; no listing is filled or applicant automatically selected.

name: Decline communication
inputs: Request ID + expected version; optional private reason.
authorization: Recipient owns pending decision.
operation: Transition pending → declined; close this request and cancel associated consent access.
destination: Closed state; sender sees generic decline without private reason.
writes: Request decision + minimal recipient/sender event.
next: Recipient may explicitly reopen/initiate later; sender cannot repeatedly reopen a declined request.
failure: Conflict returns current status; never fake a local decline.
returnBehavior: Closed state persists across cards/profiles/inbox; unrelated existing outcomes remain unchanged.

name: Withdraw a pending request or inquiry
inputs: Request/application ID + expected version; explicitly chosen scope.
authorization: Own pending request or active application; no withdrawal of another actor’s decision.
operation: Withdraw chosen entity; if pair consent is shared by other contexts, do not silently revoke that accepted relationship.
destination: Closed inquiry/request state at origin and counterpart lists.
writes: Scoped withdrawal record; no automatic quota refund.
next: Continue browsing or start a separately eligible action.
failure: Conflict explains accepted/closed state and offers relevant next action.
returnBehavior: Scope and final status remain visible; refresh cannot restore a withdrawn action.

name: Open an authorized conversation
inputs: Pair UIDs, optional authorized listing context.
authorization: Live accepted consent; no blocks or restricted participant.
operation: Resolve deterministic pair conversation; reuse legacy room through reviewed compatibility mapping.
destination: P12 with stable conversationId.
writes: Create/reuse room and optional context link, not a second consent record.
next: Read history, send text or request explicit contact disclosure.
failure: Unauthorized/stale consent → explain restriction; do not create a phantom local chat.
returnBehavior: Direct room URL reauthorizes; history is loaded by cursor, not feed tuples.

name: Send text
inputs: conversationId, clientMessageId, nonempty bounded text.
authorization: Live send authorization on commit, not just when composer opened.
operation: Persist message plus room summary and recipient delivery/read metadata idempotently.
destination: P12 acknowledged message; other participant live stream/P13 if preference permits.
writes: Message + summary + unread/read cursor state + notification event.
next: Continue conversation or record a later housing decision.
failure: Pending/failed draft remains identified; retry same client ID; no success before acknowledgement.
returnBehavior: Confirmed messages survive reload; unsent draft is clearly local and account-scoped.

name: Send an attachment
inputs: Validated supported image, size/type, upload ID and conversation scope.
authorization: Same live consent; supported bytes/MIME/size; no executable format.
operation: Upload to private chat Storage staging; validate; commit message reference only after success.
destination: P12 acknowledged image and safe preview.
writes: Authorized object + message reference; cleanup/retry job for abandoned staging.
next: View or continue chat.
failure: Upload progress/cancel/retry; block during transfer prevents final send; no base64 document fallback.
returnBehavior: Committed reference is durable; resumable drafts have explicit expiry and no cross-account leakage.

name: Mark/read and return
inputs: Last visible message/event cursor and account identity.
authorization: Self read state only.
operation: Advance per-member read cursor monotonically; derive unread count from authoritative event/message state.
destination: Inbox badge/filter and counterpart receipt only if disclosed by policy.
writes: Own read cursor; no arbitrary peer count edit.
next: Open next unread conversation or return to prior context.
failure: Read-state failure may retry quietly but must not mark undelivered content read; offline state is explicit.
returnBehavior: Read position persists; late/old snapshots cannot restore stale counts.

name: Share external contact/address
inputs: Specific contact field, intended peer, disclosure consent/version.
authorization: Owner of the data explicitly opts in; acceptance alone is insufficient.
operation: Create scoped disclosure grant or send explicit user-chosen content with retention warning.
destination: P12 disclosed subset; no automatic public profile update.
writes: Private contact grant/audit reference; raw number not placed in public source docs.
next: Withdraw future access; understand previously copied information cannot be recalled.
failure: No grant on failed consent/write; recipient sees unavailable rather than inferred number.
returnBehavior: Only still-valid grants are re-fetched; revocation removes future in-app access.

name: Block/unblock
actor: Either participant / owner of directional block
inputs: Target UID; explicit block or remove-own-block action.
authorization: Own block decision; cannot remove the peer’s block.
operation: Block transaction restricts pair authorization across all contexts; unblock removes only own record and does not restore accepted consent.
destination: Restricted history/composer and own block list.
writes: Directional block + request/authorization derived state + private audit; no block notification to peer.
next: Report/support; after all blocks removed, obtain fresh consent if recipient permits.
failure: Idempotent action; partial deletion of mirrors is prevented; do not leak who blocked whom.
returnBehavior: Restriction survives reload and applies to existing rooms, new IDs and all listing contexts.

name: Report a safety concern
inputs: Typed target ID, reason, bounded explanation and consented evidence reference.
authorization: Actor bound to Auth; valid target; rate/abuse policy.
operation: Create report/case reference and staff queue event.
destination: Acknowledged case with safety options; P22 scoped queue.
writes: Private moderation case and minimal event; no automatic guilt/tenancy action.
next: Block if wanted, preserve allowed evidence, seek support.
failure: Retry same report ID; never tell the user a failed report reached staff.
returnBehavior: Own acknowledgement/reference persists without exposing private staff notes or other reporters.

name: Create/resume listing draft
inputs: Typed listing kind/unit, draft ID/version and explicit authorization/residence declarations.
authorization: Self/assigned publisher capability and complete shared profile; no false legal ownership inference.
operation: Create/resume owned private draft before listing-scoped uploads.
destination: P15 same step/draft.
writes: Private listing draft and staged objects, not public availability.
next: Save draft, complete remaining fields, preview or submit.
failure: Stage-specific validation; failed upload retains draft ID and selected source; no active publication.
returnBehavior: Owned draft can resume by ID; Close warns about unsaved changes.

name: Submit property for review
inputs: Complete draft/version, photos, actual price/unit/capacity, questions, consent and identity prerequisite status.
authorization: Configured publication prerequisites; declared data passes shared schema.
operation: Submit immutable review version; enqueue staff review; keep previous approved version policy explicit for edits.
destination: P14 pending/changes requested; P22 review queue.
writes: Review submission/version + outbox; public projection remains absent or prior approved version only.
next: Wait, withdraw draft or respond to a review request.
failure: No upload/validation/network failure can report Published; retries use same submission ID.
returnBehavior: Exact submitted version/status and staff notes remain visible.

name: Approve/request changes on property
inputs: Submission ID/version, decision and reason.
authorization: Explicit property-review capability; publisher eligibility/identity prerequisites checked.
operation: Approve exact content version or request changes; derive public availability from all independent gates.
destination: Publisher P14/P15; eligible public detail/feed.
writes: Review decision + published projection/outbox atomically or a tracked job.
next: Publisher can advertise/reconfirm; rejected version can be corrected/resubmitted.
failure: Conflict refreshes reviewed version; no approval of a newer unseen draft.
returnBehavior: Staff/publisher/public see the same effective version and clear status.

name: Edit published property
inputs: Listing ID/version and field-level diff.
authorization: Owner/assigned publisher; current account active.
operation: Save new draft; material price/location/capacity/residence/trust-sensitive edits require configured re-review. Safe editorial changes follow an explicit allowlist.
destination: P15/P14 with prior published versus pending version clearly separated.
writes: New draft/review version; effective public record changes only after required approval.
next: Submit review, discard draft or retain prior approved record as allowed.
failure: Stale edit returns conflict and comparison; never overwrite concurrent availability silently.
returnBehavior: Discard affects draft only; all pages resolve effective published version.

name: Pause/reconfirm/fill/reopen a listing
inputs: Listing ID/version, desired availability and explicit confirmation.
authorization: Current publishability/account checks; reopen requires valid approval/trust/freshness.
operation: Change availability independently from publication review. Filled is an explicit host confirmation of zero availability.
destination: P14, public listing tombstone, Saved/context cards and host eligibility.
writes: Availability/version + public projection/outbox; no automatic tenant assignment.
next: Correct declaration, reopen if eligible or complete optional outcome follow-up.
failure: Conflict preserves latest value; no silent active fallback for pending/rejected accounts.
returnBehavior: True state persists; filled/expired leave new discovery but authorized history remains understandable.

name: Review/shortlist/decline/select an applicant
inputs: Application ID/version, stage and optional private note.
authorization: Listing ownership; stage transition allowed; applicant disclosure scope valid.
operation: Commit owner-scoped application stage; selected expresses intended housing decision only. Communication acceptance is a separate labelled command.
destination: Applicant list/detail and appropriate applicant status notice.
writes: Application stage/note and event; no implicit connection acceptance or listing fill.
next: Explicit chat consent, mutual housing acknowledgement or host availability confirmation.
failure: Await commit; current stage on conflict; cannot decline an accepted relationship by pretending it is applicant tracking.
returnBehavior: Stages reload from records, not APS/index-local state.

name: Declare housing/team-up outcome
inputs: Outcome type, contextual entity, source/self-report and remaining intent choices.
authorization: Self declaration; mutual claim requires both acknowledgements; owner controls listing availability independently.
operation: Record private outcome; explicitly update only chosen search intents/opt-in; prompt host separately if relevant.
destination: Private outcome summary and optional next activity.
writes: Outcome declaration/version and consented aggregate event.
next: Continue a remaining intent, pause discovery or return later; no booking/lease created.
failure: Member can correct a declaration; no automatic publication, quota or peer-state mutation on failed follow-up.
returnBehavior: Outcome remains labelled self-reported/mutual; others never receive fabricated occupancy proof.

name: Save/discard profile/preferences/avatar
inputs: Versioned complete draft with preserved undisplayed fields and selected disclosure.
authorization: Self; allowed editable fields; no staff/trust/status/grant changes.
operation: Validate shared profile/preferences contract; stage avatar object; commit all explicit edits or discard without publishing them.
destination: P18 overview and own public preview.
writes: Profile/private preferences/disclosure projection version; object reference only on commit.
next: Return to intended marketplace action or adjust remaining preferences.
failure: Field errors preserve draft; upload failure does not erase prior avatar; conflict offers field comparison.
returnBehavior: Refresh shows confirmed saved state; discard preserves prior image and all undisplayed localities.

name: Submit/review/resubmit ID
inputs: Private supported document, declared name/type, consent; reviewer sees submission ID/version.
authorization: Owner self-submit; reviewer capability; evidence purpose/retention disclosed.
operation: Stage private object; submit immutable evidence version; reviewer approves/rejects exact version with reason; mirror trust from decision.
destination: P19 status/note; publisher prerequisites and staff queues.
writes: Versioned verification/evidence pointer/audit/trust mirrors; no Aadhaar certification or property auto-activation.
next: Rejected owner corrects and submits new version; approved member sees precisely scoped badge.
failure: Reject unsupported/oversized/legacy active content; old review cannot overwrite new submission; cleanup has retry state.
returnBehavior: Version/history and actual decision remain; no bearer ID URL or fabricated Verified screen.

name: Change credentials/logout
inputs: Provider-appropriate reauthentication, new credentials or sign-out request.
authorization: Auth owner; recent auth for sensitive change.
operation: Use Auth service; clear/rekey session caches on sign-out/account switch.
destination: Confirmation or original public context.
writes: Auth identity state; verified email change only after actual verification.
next: Sign back in, recover access or return to the product.
failure: Provider-specific explanation; no false password or email success; preserve safe return context.
returnBehavior: No prior account draft/private state is shown after switch; session expires into safe resume flow.

name: Set privacy/notifications
inputs: Specific supported setting and disclosure scope/version.
authorization: Own enforceable preference; required security notices distinguished from optional marketing.
operation: Persist setting; apply it to profile projection/notification delivery, not just a toggle.
destination: P20 and all affected public/private surfaces.
writes: Preference/disclosure version + cache invalidation/job state if needed.
next: Preview disclosure, revoke optional grants or retry propagation.
failure: Keep previous confirmed toggle on failure; explicitly unavailable features cannot pretend to save.
returnBehavior: Reload and a second authorized account observe the enforced setting.

name: Export/delete account
inputs: Recent auth, exact requested scope, explicit deletion confirmation and retention disclosure.
authorization: Self only; preserve support/appeal/data rights for restricted accounts subject to reviewed policy.
operation: Create tracked private export/deletion job; collect current IDs/fields/storage bucket; enforce approved retention and peer-history decisions.
destination: Job status/secured download or deletion completion; logged out only after actual completion.
writes: Job manifest/progress/audit; applicable data objects; Auth identity at safe final stage.
next: Retry/recover, download within disclosed expiry or receive truthful completion summary.
failure: Partial failures remain retryable; no false email/deletion; short-lived download access is owner-only.
returnBehavior: Owner can resume job safely; completed erasure cannot be reset by profile recreation.

name: Suspend/ban/reinstate an account
inputs: Target UID/version, allowed sanction, reason and review scope.
authorization: Capability-scoped trusted staff; cannot self-reinstate or escalate membership.
operation: Commit sanction and derive all publication/send restrictions; propagation is atomic or a tracked job with visible pending state.
destination: Staff case, member restriction notice/support and affected discovery/relationships.
writes: Moderation decision + account/publication policy versions + event/audit.
next: Member appeal; authorized reinstatement re-evaluates prerequisites instead of blindly reactivating every listing.
failure: Failed propagation is not completed sanction; stale target requires review; preserve private reasons appropriately.
returnBehavior: Every page/rules path enforces effective status, including existing chat rooms and shared links.

name: Resolve report/review staff work
inputs: Case/version, typed target, note, outcome and any required sanction.
authorization: Least-privilege capability; evidence access logged.
operation: Apply case outcome and required sanction atomically or through a visible applying→completed workflow.
destination: Consistent staff queue and safe reporter/member acknowledgement.
writes: Case outcome/note/audit plus associated action job.
next: Reopen/review if action fails or new evidence arrives.
failure: A failed sanction leaves applying/failed state, never a misleading Resolved result.
returnBehavior: Reason/outcome and exact action status survive reload; case history is auditable.

name: Send broadcast/manage staff
inputs: Explicit grant versus invitation; broadcast audience snapshot, message and confirmed job.
authorization: Staff-management and broadcast capabilities checked server-side independently of Moderator UI visibility.
operation: Create audited membership grant or invitation; create idempotent delivery job with recipient counts and retries.
destination: Correct staff list/invitation state or queued/sending/delivered/failed broadcast state.
writes: Grant/invite job or broadcast/outbox recipient-delivery records; never generic fake success.
next: Track actual acceptance/delivery or revoke permitted access.
failure: Failed write remains failed; no silent local save or Invitation sent without delivery.
returnBehavior: Same job/grant identity remains visible; live environment/project label is accurate.
